text: ya that makes sense the only problem is that the current anything that is 'select faces and ...' has a very horrible compounding failure in that lets say for a lavalamp, that you would want to have the lava across N faces, basically the way as everything is approached says every face = brand new, full instance paint. so you will end up with a horrible look if you follow that same idea
resolution: Design assessment (no code): agreed the per-face/per-group instancing is the fault — every face gets its own groupBasisFor planar frame, so an N-face material restarts N times with seams. Resolution proposed: live materials bind to a MATERIAL REGION (face set + spec + data + domain), and the default domain is object-space 3D position — all faces sample one continuous field, continuity comes from the domain not stitching; perFace/planar become explicit opt-in modes for signage-like cases. Plasma extends (u,v)->(x,y,z). Same shape the painted-ground FILL_FUNCS live dispatch already proved over world XZ; models never got their equivalent. Baked paint shares the disease and can adopt region domains later.
